set.body: Keep project-global AnalysisRevision and RunId identities unchanged. A separate positive nominal AnalysisFamilyId owns saved revisions through a checked registry; names and presets are display/configuration, never identity. Legacy documents imply one real family1 for every known saved revision and initial/existing working draft; an empty project has none. No emitted family member, null, schema-selection change, canonical byte/digest change or journal checkpoint change in legacy mode. Explicit registry ownership must cover exactly known saved revision IDs without duplicate, unknown or unused family/owner entries; parse vectors before maps. An existing draft inherits its saved base family, never independently assigns another one. A future NewFamily seeded origin carries provisional identity/name/data/recipe without a synthetic base; one project-wide draft remains; existing-origin NoChanges remains. SaveAndRun atomically materializes family and revision ownership; discarding a provisional family restores exact prior representation. Multi-family document decode must land atomically with safe family-scoped supersession/banner/recipe interpretation and registry-preserving reducer rebuilds; hiding UI creation is insufficient. Global latest-admitted DatasetMoved policy remains unchanged. Registry-only and NewFamily schema/command changes get distinct conditional rungs allocated after data/trials landing. Four slices: identity/legacy foundation; persistence and safe interpretation; independent seeded lifecycle; UI/selected-family editing.
set.title: Decision: analysis families have nominal identity and explicit revision ownership
